lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p23 - Talk about the pictures. Make predictions.

details: Talk about the pictures activates prior knowledge and visual literacy. Students describe the scene (cat in tree, dog barking) and identify the job characters to predict the plot.
Look for recognition of the "police officer" and "vet" uniforms and simple predictions about how they will help the cat.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p23 - Listen to the story.

details: Listen to the story develops narrative comprehension. Students listen to the audio to follow the sequence of the rescue and understand the specific dialogue ("I can help," "I'm a vet").
Look for attentive listening and reaction to the vet climbing the tree to save the cat.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p23 - Act it out.

details: Act it out builds confidence and fluency. Students role-play the characters, using the key phrases "I'm a [job]" and "I can help" in a meaningful context.
Look for enthusiastic participation, clear delivery of the lines, and appropriate actions (e.g., looking up at the tree, climbing).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p101 - Follow and colour from 10 to 70.

details: Follow and colour reinforces the numerical sequence by tens. Students identify the path from 10 to 70 and colour the corresponding bubbles to connect the firefighter to the fire engine.
Look for accurate identification of the sequence 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70 and colouring only those circles.

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p101 - Go back. Count by 10s.

details: Go back and count introduces reverse sequencing. Students trace the path backwards from the fire engine to the firefighter, counting down from 70 to 10.
Look for students pointing to the circles in reverse order and verbally counting "70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 20, 10."

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p102 - Add and write.

details: Add and write develops calculation skills using visual support. Students count the base sets (e.g., 30 apples) and add the group of 10 to find the total (40).
Look for correct calculation of the sums (30+10=40, 40+10=50, 50+10=60, 60+10=70) and writing the answers on the lines.
